sprintSummary.budgetImpact: Austere 30-min CMS Quick Sprint (0.5 hrs) — Resolves 4 missing location meta descriptions, fixes 3 malformed phone/web links, and adds 301 redirect for Wet-Check.

tasks.title: Add High-CTR Meta Descriptions on Location Landing Pages (San Antonio & Tampa)
tasks.rootCause: WHERE ON PAGE / DOM: <head> -> <meta name="description">. Core regional franchise location pages /san-antonio-tx/ and /tampa-fl/ are missing meta descriptions entirely, forcing Google to generate dynamic snippets.
tasks.businessImpact: Improves local search organic CTR and prevents random page fragment text from appearing in competitive San Antonio and Tampa search results.
tasks.technicalInstructions:
1. In WordPress Admin -> Pages -> Edit 'San Antonio, TX' -> Rank Math Meta Box -> Description:
   'Professional lawn sprinkler and irrigation services in San Antonio, TX. Pacific Lawn Sprinklers offers repairs, installations, and seasonal maintenance. Call today!' (153 chars)
2. Edit 'Tampa, FL' -> Rank Math Meta Box -> Description:
   'Top-rated lawn sprinkler installation, repair, and landscape lighting in Tampa, FL. Count on Pacific Lawn Sprinklers for reliable, eco-friendly irrigation services.' (154 chars)
acceptanceCriteria: Both location URLs output verified custom meta description tags in DOM.

tasks.title: Fix Malformed Relative Telephone Links (href="/tel:...")
tasks.rootCause: WHERE ON PAGE / DOM: Hardcoded telephone links containing leading slashes: href="/tel:888-438-7224" (2 inlinks) and href="/tel:8884387224" (3 inlinks). Web browsers and search crawlers resolve these as relative paths on the domain, producing 404 errors.
tasks.businessImpact: Eliminates 5 internal 404 errors and ensures mobile click-to-call triggers the native phone dialer immediately for prospective customers.
tasks.technicalInstructions: Search post content and header/footer widgets for '/tel:' and remove the leading slash so links read strictly: href="tel:888-438-7224" and href="tel:8884387224".
acceptanceCriteria: All telephone anchors in DOM output valid tel: URI scheme without leading slash.
Crawler encounters zero 404 errors on telephone strings.

tasks.title: Implement 301 Permanent Redirect for Legacy Wet-Check Page
tasks.rootCause: WHERE ON PAGE / DOM: Legacy DotNetNuke URL /Services/Lawn-Sprinkler-Systems/Inspection-Wet-Check is linked in internal post content (2 inlinks) but returns HTTP 404 because no 301 redirect rule was established during migration.
tasks.businessImpact: Recovers internal link equity and directs visitors searching for wet-check inspections to the modern active service category.
tasks.technicalInstructions:
In WordPress Admin -> Rank Math -> Redirections -> Add New:
- Source URL: /Services/Lawn-Sprinkler-Systems/Inspection-Wet-Check
- Destination URL: https://www.pacificlawnsprinklers.com/services/lawn-sprinkler-systems/
- Redirection Type: 301 Permanent Move

tasks.title: Fix Malformed External Link (href="www.pacificlawnsprinklers.com")
tasks.rootCause: WHERE ON PAGE / DOM: In-content link written as href="www.pacificlawnsprinklers.com" missing the https:// protocol scheme, causing the browser to append it to the current path and return 404.
tasks.businessImpact: Cleans up internal broken link and ensures users navigating to homepage reach 200 OK cleanly.
tasks.technicalInstructions: Locate the affected post content via inlinks and update anchor href from 'www.pacificlawnsprinklers.com' to 'https://www.pacificlawnsprinklers.com/'.
acceptanceCriteria: Link points to absolute https:// URL with 200 OK.
tasks.verificationMethod: Verify href attribute in post HTML

tasks.title: Fix Critical Canonical Tag Override on Corporate Form (/pls-corporate-form/)
tasks.rootCause:
1. SYMPTOM & EVIDENCE: https://www.pacificlawnsprinklers.com/pls-corporate-form/ outputs <link rel="canonical" href="https://www.pacificlawnsprinklers.com/about/blog/">.
2. ROOT CAUSE: Hardcoded canonical override in post meta or template-parts/pls-corporate.php instructing Google to index blog index instead of form.
tasks.businessImpact: Prevents catastrophic canonical mismatch where Google de-indexes the corporate customer intake form.
tasks.technicalInstructions: Clear custom canonical field in Rank Math page meta or remove manual rel="canonical" output in theme template, restoring standard wp_get_canonical_url().

tasks.title: Fix Blog Archive Pagination 404 Loops (/page/5/ & ?cat=14)
tasks.rootCause:
1. SYMPTOM & EVIDENCE: /about/blog/page/5/ and /about/blog/page/4/?cat=14 return 404 Not Found, but are linked by archive pagination buttons.
2. ROOT CAUSE: Custom pagination helper uses global post count rather than filtered taxonomy term query, generating links to pages that have zero posts.
tasks.businessImpact: Eliminates 9 inlinks pointing to broken 404 archive pages, protecting search crawler crawl budget.
acceptanceCriteria: Pagination controls never render page links beyond $blog_query->max_num_pages.
Zero 404 responses encountered on pagination links.

tasks.title: Replace 17 Internal DotNetNuke Redirect Links in Theme Templates
tasks.rootCause:
1. SYMPTOM & EVIDENCE: 17 internal links trigger 301 redirects to lowercase/modern slugs (e.g. /About-Us/Company-Info -> /about/ with 11 inlinks).
2. ROOT CAUSE: Hardcoded legacy DotNetNuke URLs in navigation menus, footer widgets, and Gutenberg template parts.
tasks.businessImpact: Eliminates 17 internal redirect hops across the site, speeding up navigation and preserving link equity.
tasks.technicalInstructions:
1. Update Appearance > Menus to modern lowercase slugs.
2. Execute WP-CLI search-replace across wp_posts:
wp search-replace '/About-Us/Company-Info' '/about/' --dry-run
wp search-replace '/Services/Lawn-Sprinkler-Systems/' '/services/lawn-sprinkler-systems/' --dry-run
acceptanceCriteria: All navigation menus and footer widgets link directly to canonical 200 OK URLs.
tasks.verificationMethod: Verify menu HTML source code for modern lowercase slugs

tasks.title: Dynamic Heading (H1) and Title on Blog Taxonomy Archives
tasks.rootCause:
1. SYMPTOM & EVIDENCE: 16 blog category pagination pages duplicate the exact same Title and H1: 'Outdoor Service Tips & Pacific Lawn Sprinklers News'.
2. ROOT CAUSE: archive-blog.php hardcodes static blog title instead of querying single_cat_title().
tasks.businessImpact: Eliminates duplicate H1 tags across 16 category pages and establishes proper semantic heading hierarchy.
tasks.technicalInstructions:
In archive-blog.php:

— Tips & News

Outdoor Service Tips & Pacific Lawn Sprinklers News
acceptanceCriteria: Category archive pages output dynamic H1 including category name.

tasks.title: Trim 29 Page Titles Exceeding 60 Characters & Replace Legacy Blog Asset
tasks.rootCause: 29 page titles truncate in SERPs due to site title suffix ' | Pacific Lawn Sprinklers', and 1 legacy 2017 blog post references a missing DotNetNuke rotator thumbnail (/Portals/0/EasyDNNRotator/2680/thumb/thumb_neigj02k.jpg).
tasks.businessImpact: Polishes search snippet display and eliminates broken thumbnail reference on legacy content.
tasks.technicalInstructions: 1. Review 29 titles identified in Master Workbook Tab 'Immediate Actions' and adjust character counts under 60 chars. 2. In 2017 blog post, remove broken tag or replace with high-resolution image asset.
acceptanceCriteria: Targeted page titles render without truncation in SERP simulators.
Broken image call removed from post HTML.
tasks.verificationMethod: Inspect page title lengths in Screaming Frog

completedTasks.title: Full 4,052-URL Screaming Frog Deep Crawl, Semrush Reconciliation & 5-Tab Master Technical SEO Workbook
completedTasks.summary: Completed full empirical crawl across Pacific Lawn Sprinklers architecture (4,052 URLs, 99.3% 200 OK). Reconciled Semrush crawler limitations, debunked 682 temporary 302 redirects as Cloudflare WAF bot-challenge false positives, identified 1 critical canonical bug (/pls-corporate-form/), mapped all 17 permanent 301 redirects, and isolated exact root causes for all 9 404 URLs.
